name: Round 3 matrix characterisation and sealed input generation

generator.site_seed_formula: site_seed = 300000 + cell_index * 1000 + split_index * 100 + replicate_index; split_index train=0 validation=1 sealed=2 generalisation=3

core_matrix.sound_type_assignment: alternating replicates, balanced within each split

generalisation.factor_sampling: deterministic uniform draws from all core factor levels; one fresh site seed per site

realism_decomposition.design: one-at-a-time plus all pairwise component combinations
realism_decomposition.seed_policy: unique per site; common random numbers within a matched component contrast

timing_probe.sites: first train replicate, impulsive sound, for each open/mixed/dense_urban x ground/aerial stationary one-source cell
timing_probe.purpose: measure render and analysis stage times for each distinct scene type before matrix grading

expanded_timing_probe.sites: first train replicate, impulsive sound, for each of the 24 core cells
expanded_timing_probe.purpose: measure effects of source count and motion before sizing the matrix baseline

matrix-smoke.cells: open/mixed/dense_urban x ground/aerial; stationary; one source

baseline_population.density_sweep_exclusion: exclude any site with 8 nodes or 80 m spacing first
baseline_population.resume: exact benchmark run cache; save final per-cell summaries and raw complete report
baseline_population.selection_basis: fixed preregistered cut order and recorded timing probe only; never accuracy outcomes

acceptance.position_change: rule 4 from docs/round2-method.md, by split and realism, with site-clustered intervals
report: events within 10 m with misses as failures
acceptance.subset: also report detectable-by-at-least-3-nodes once the label is implemented

metric_definitions.coverage: Expected source events with an assigned fix divided by all expected source events.
metric_definitions.events_within_10m_misses_counted: Expected source events with an assigned fix at most 10 m divided by all expected source events; missed events fail.
metric_definitions.detectable_3_node_fraction: Expected source events with source-aligned measured tracks at three or more nodes divided by all expected source events; a track must have a window during the source clip within 10 degrees of the true source bearing.
metric_definitions.detectable_3_node_events_within_10m: Among events detectable at three or more nodes, fraction with an assigned fix at most 10 m.
metric_definitions.fix_probability_metrics: Brier, log loss, error-over-10-m AUROC and reliability error use per-fix p_wrong; unavailable if any included fix lacks p_wrong.

acceptance.undersized_groups: Groups with fewer than five distinct sites are descriptive only; no tier color or population ranking.

cut_order: drop 8-node and 80 m density sweep cases
reduce per-cell matrix sites toward five, never drop a core cell
seal_policy: Generate and hash the full sealed input population in this mission; never run it. It is reserved for 3D only.

results.interpretation: Descriptive synthetic results only. Core, generalisation, and density populations are not field validation. No solver changes were selected from these outcomes.
